antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 635nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in endothelial if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Intense 810nm: high power 2W laser, 370 THz, 10^-15s, single pulse for acute effect targeting NO_synthase in endothelial.
